generated_by: tools/v31-build-pdf-pagemap.py (workspace copy, not shipped in package)
purpose_zh: 把四份 A3/A0 PDF 的全部页面逐页登记为可核验条目，回应评审「PDF 仅提供首页预览、不能仅凭首页推断全部页面内容」的意见：读者不打开 PDF 即可核对每一页的章节、图幅、字符量与文本指纹。
purpose_en: Registers every page of the four A3/A0 PDFs as a verifiable entry, answering the reviewer note that only the first PDF page is previewed and full-page content cannot be inferred from it: readers can audit every page's section, figures, character count and text digest without opening the PDFs.
method_zh: PyMuPDF 逐页文本抽取；文本指纹为页面 get_text() 的 UTF-8 SHA-256；文件指纹为 PDF 字节 SHA-256。抽取只读不写，不改变任何图纸内容。
method_en: PyMuPDF per-page text extraction; page digest = SHA-256 of the page get_text() UTF-8 bytes; file digest = SHA-256 of the PDF bytes. Extraction is read-only and alters no drawing content.
limitations_zh: 本件登记的是文本层可抽取内容（标题、图号、字符量、指纹）；版式与图形渲染仍以 PDF 本体为准，字体覆盖另见 webfont-coverage-evidence.json。
limitations_en: This registers the text layer only (headings, figure ids, character counts, digests); layout and vector rendering remain governed by the PDFs themselves, and font coverage is evidenced separately in webfont-coverage-evidence.json.
